name: Crystal Casket
body:
School evocation [earth]; Level sorcerer/wizard 5

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You encase the target in a crystalline structure that is 1 inch thick per caster level. If the target fails their Reflex save, it is helpless, but held in stasis and will not age, need to eat, or breathe. A creature that succeeds on their saving throw is entangled but not held in stasis for the duration or until the crystal is broken. The crystal blocks line of effect, but not line of sight, though the creature cannot be affected by any mind-affecting effects while in the crystal. The crystal has a hardness of 2 and 5 hit points per inch of thickness. If the crystal is broken, the creature is freed. A creature can break the crystal as a full-round action with a successful Strength check (DC 15 + your caster level).

This spell can be made permanent with the permanency spell with a minimum caster level of 13th and 18,000 gp.
